verdict.rationale: Nix's core workflow (nix-shell/nix develop, flakes with `nix build`/`nix run`) lets a developer clone a repo with a flake.nix or shell.nix and get a fully declared build/dev environment with one command, corroborated by both official docs (nix-docs-2,3,14,22,34) and hands-on community testimony (nix-comm-7 describing nix-shell reliably pulling correct dependencies). missing for 10: no direct first-party 'git clone && one command' walkthrough tying it explicitly to a fresh clone scenario, and some community friction reports around setup complexity (nix-comm-4,8) show real-world onboarding isn't always frictionless.
